description_en:
Queries a list of permission application orders.

Note: The 2020 version of OpenAPI will be discontinued at a scheduled time. Please migrate to the 2024 version of OpenAPI as soon as possible — ListMyApplications/ListPendingApprovals/ListMyRelatedApprovals
description_zh:
查询权限申请单列表。

注意：2020版OpenAPI将择期下线，请尽快迁移至2024版OpenAPI —— ListMyApplications/ListPendingApprovals/ListMyRelatedApprovals
name: ListPermissionApplyOrders

parameters.help_en:
The status of the application order. Valid values:
1: Pending approval.
2: Approved, authorization succeeded.
3: Approved, authorization failed.
4: Rejected.
5: Withdrawn
parameters.help_zh:
申请单的状态。取值如下：
1：待审批。
2：审批通过，授权成功。
3：审批通过，授权失败。
4：审批拒绝。
5:   撤回申请单
parameters.name: flow_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the application order belongs. If this parameter is not specified, application orders from all workspaces are returned. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Settings page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: 申请单所属的工作空间ID，不输入则返回所有工作空间的申请单。您可登录DataWorks控制台，进入工作空间配置页面，查询工作空间ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: This parameter is deprecated and does not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 该字段已废弃，不会生效
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute project to which the application order belongs. If this parameter is not specified, application orders from all MaxCompute projects are returned
parameters.help_zh: 申请单所属的MaxCompute项目名称，不输入则返回所有MaxCompute项目的申请单
parameters.name: max_compute_project_name

parameters.help_en: The table name included in the application order. If this parameter is not specified, application orders for all tables are returned
parameters.help_zh: 申请单包含的表名称，不输入则返回所有表的申请单
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en: The start time for querying application orders, specified as a UNIX timestamp. If this parameter is not specified, all application orders are queried
parameters.help_zh: 查询目标起始时间发起的申请单，配置为一个unix时间戳。不输入则表示查询所有的申请单
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for querying application orders, specified as a UNIX timestamp. If this parameter is not specified, application orders up to the current time are queried
parameters.help_zh: 查询目标截至时间的申请单，配置为一个unix时间戳。不输入则表示查询截至当前时间的申请单
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: This parameter is deprecated and does not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 该字段已废弃，不会生效
parameters.name: engine_type

parameters.help_en: The page number for paginated queries. The value must be a positive integer greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询页码。大于等于1的正整数，默认为1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The query type of the application order. Valid values:
0: Application orders submitted by me.
1: Application orders approved by me.
2: All application orders
parameters.help_zh:
申请单的查询类型。取值如下：
0：我提交的申请单。
1：由我审批的申请单。
2:  全部申请单
parameters.name: query_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the application order. Valid values:

[MaxComputeTable] MaxCompute table permission application order.
[MaxComputeFunction] MaxCompute function application order.
[MaxComputeResource] MaxCompute resource application order.
[DLFSchema] DLF 1.0 schema permission application order.
[DLFTable] DLF 1.0 table permission application order.
[DLFColumn] DLF 1.0 column permission application order.
[DsApiDeploy] DataService publishing permission application order
parameters.help_zh:
设置申请单类型，枚举值为：

[ MaxComputeTable]  MaxCompute表权限申请单
[ MaxComputeFunction] MaxCompute函数申请单
[ MaxComputeResource] MaxCompute资源申请单
[ DLFSchema] DLF1.0版本Schema权限申请单
[ DLFTable] DLF1.0版本表权限申请单
[ DLFColumn] DLF1.0版本列权限申请单
[ DsApiDeploy] 发布数据服务权限申请单
parameters.name: apply_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog to query
parameters.name: catalog_name

ApplyOrders.description_en: The paginated query results of permission application orders
ApplyOrders.description_zh: 权限申请单的分页查询结果

ApplyOrder.description_en: The list of permission application orders

ApplyBaseId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud user UID that submitted the application order
ApplyBaseId.description_zh: 提交申请单的阿里云用户UID

ApplyTimestamp.description_en: The submission time of the application order, displayed as a UNIX timestamp
ApplyTimestamp.description_zh: 申请单的提交时间，显示为一个unix时间戳

ApproveContent.description_en: The content of the application order

ApplyReason.description_en: The reason for the application, used by the administrator for evaluation and approval
ApplyReason.description_zh: 申请的原因。用于管理员进行评估审批
ApplyReason.example: I need to use this table

OrderType.description_en: The application order type. Currently, only the value 1 is supported, indicating an object ACL permission application
OrderType.description_zh: 申请单类型。目前仅支持取值为1，表示对象ACL权限申请

ProjectMeta.description_en: The content of the applied object

ObjectMetaList.description_en: The information about the applied objects

items.description_en:
The permission types applied for. Multiple permission types in a single application are separated by commas (,).
Currently, only Select, Describe, Drop, Alter, Update, and Download types are supported
items.description_zh:
申请的权限类型，一次申请多种类型权限时使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
目前仅支持申请Select、Describe、Drop、Alter、Update、Download类型

ObjectName.description_en: The name of the applied table

WorkspaceName.description_en: The name of the DataWorks workspace to which the MaxCompute project with the requested permissions belongs
WorkspaceName.description_zh: 申请权限的MaxCompute项目所属的DataWorks工作空间名称

FinishApprovalTimestamp.description_en: The final approval completion time, displayed as a UNIX timestamp
FinishApprovalTimestamp.description_zh: 最终审批结束时间。显示为一个unix时间戳

FlowStatus.description_en:
The status of the application order. Valid values:

1：待审批。
2：审批通过，授权成功。

4：审批拒绝。
5：撤回申请单

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of permission application orders returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 返回的权限申请单总数
